description: Logs based NotebookLM Adoption & Usage - stable version (v.20.04.1343

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
SELECT
  -- Extracts the JSON field and casts it as a STRING for the dashboard
  MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) AS Notebook_Title,
  
  -- Uses JSON_VALUE to safely compare the label to our target string
  COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GetNotebook") AS Notebook_Opens,
  
  COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GenerateFreeFormStreamed") AS Total_Questions_Asked,
  
  -- Distinct counts also require a standard SQL type (STRING) rather than a JSON type
  COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.userIamPrincipal)) AS Unique_Users

FROM
  `<project_id>.<location>.notebooklm-activity-bucket._AllLogs`

WHERE
  -- Safely comparing the JSON fields to Strings in the WHERE clause
  JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) = "google.cloud.notebooklm.v1main.NotebookService"
  AND JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) IN ("GetNotebook", "GenerateFreeFormStreamed")

GROUP BY
  -- We group by the String representation of the ID
  JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.name)

HAVING
  -- 1. Ensure the notebook was actually opened at least once
  COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GetNotebook") > 0
  
  -- 2. Completely ignore the notebook if it never got a valid name (null or empty)
  AND MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) IS NOT NULL 
  AND MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) != ""

ORDER BY
  -- Sorted by opens to match the widget's purpose
  Notebook_Opens DESC

-- 1. Grab the actual data exactly like we did before
WITH HourlyNotebookData AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, HOUR) AS time_window,
    MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) AS Notebook_Title,
    COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GetNotebook") AS Notebook_Opens
  FROM
    `<project_id>.<location>.notebooklm-activity-bucket._AllLogs`
  WHERE
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) = "google.cloud.notebooklm.v1main.NotebookService"
    AND JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) IN ("GetNotebook", "GenerateFreeFormStreamed")
  GROUP BY
    time_window,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.name)
),

-- 2. Clean it up (handle duplicates and nulls)
CleanedData AS (
  SELECT
    time_window,
    COALESCE(Notebook_Title, "Unknown Notebook") AS Notebook_Title,
    SUM(Notebook_Opens) AS Notebook_Opens
  FROM HourlyNotebookData
  WHERE Notebook_Opens > 0
  GROUP BY time_window, Notebook_Title
),

-- 3. Create a continuous unbroken timeline of every hour 
TimeSpine AS (
  SELECT time_window
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(
    (SELECT MIN(time_window) FROM CleanedData), 
    (SELECT MAX(time_window) FROM CleanedData), 
    INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  )) AS time_window
),

-- 4. Get a master list of all notebooks that exist in this time period
UniqueNotebooks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Notebook_Title FROM CleanedData
),

-- 5. Cross join them: Create a blank row for EVERY hour for EVERY notebook
PerfectGrid AS (
  SELECT t.time_window, n.Notebook_Title
  FROM TimeSpine t
  CROSS JOIN UniqueNotebooks n
)

-- 6. Blend the Perfect Grid with the Actual Data, replacing missing data with 0
SELECT
  grid.time_window,
  grid.Notebook_Title,
  COALESCE(actual.Notebook_Opens, 0) AS Notebook_Opens
FROM PerfectGrid grid
LEFT JOIN CleanedData actual
  ON grid.time_window = actual.time_window 
  AND grid.Notebook_Title = actual.Notebook_Title
ORDER BY grid.time_window ASC

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
SELECT
  MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) AS Notebook_Title,
  COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GetNotebook") AS Notebook_Opens,
  COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GenerateFreeFormStreamed") AS Total_Questions_Asked,
  COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.userIamPrincipal)) AS Unique_Users
FROM
  `<project_id>.<location>.notebooklm-activity-bucket._AllLogs`
WHERE
  JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) = "google.cloud.notebooklm.v1main.NotebookService"
  AND JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) IN ("GetNotebook", "GenerateFreeFormStreamed")
GROUP BY
  JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.name)
HAVING
  -- 1. Ensure the notebook had at least one chat question asked
  COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GenerateFreeFormStreamed") > 0
  
  -- 2. Completely ignore the notebook if it never got a valid name (null or empty)
  AND MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) IS NOT NULL 
  AND MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) != ""
ORDER BY
  -- Sorted by questions asked to match the widget's purpose
  Total_Questions_Asked DESC

WITH HourlyNotebookData AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, HOUR) AS time_window,
    MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.title)) AS Notebook_Title,
    COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) = "GenerateFreeFormStreamed") AS Questions_Asked
  FROM
    `<project_id>.<location>.notebooklm-activity-bucket._AllLogs`
  WHERE
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) = "google.cloud.notebooklm.v1main.NotebookService"
    AND JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) IN ("GetNotebook", "GenerateFreeFormStreamed")
  GROUP BY
    time_window,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.name)
),

-- 2. Clean it up
CleanedData AS (
  SELECT
    time_window,
    COALESCE(Notebook_Title, "Unknown Notebook") AS Notebook_Title,
    SUM(Questions_Asked) AS Questions_Asked
  FROM HourlyNotebookData
  WHERE Questions_Asked > 0
  GROUP BY time_window, Notebook_Title
),

-- 3. Create a continuous unbroken timeline of every hour 
TimeSpine AS (
  SELECT time_window
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(
    (SELECT MIN(time_window) FROM CleanedData), 
    (SELECT MAX(time_window) FROM CleanedData), 
    INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  )) AS time_window
),

-- 4. Get a master list of all notebooks that exist in this time period
UniqueNotebooks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Notebook_Title FROM CleanedData
),

-- 5. Cross join them: Create a blank row for EVERY hour for EVERY notebook
PerfectGrid AS (
  SELECT t.time_window, n.Notebook_Title
  FROM TimeSpine t
  CROSS JOIN UniqueNotebooks n
)

-- 6. Blend the Perfect Grid with the Actual Data, replacing missing chat data with 0
SELECT
  grid.time_window,
  grid.Notebook_Title,
  COALESCE(actual.Questions_Asked, 0) AS Questions_Asked
FROM PerfectGrid grid
LEFT JOIN CleanedData actual
  ON grid.time_window = actual.time_window 
  AND grid.Notebook_Title = actual.Notebook_Title
ORDER BY grid.time_window ASC
